reason: In services/src/main/java/org/keycloak/protocol/oidc/encode/DefaultTokenContextEncoderProviderFactory.java, both lazy refresh methods—getShortcutByGrantType (lines 106-119) and getGrantTypeByShortcut (lines 121-137)—insert directly into grantsByShortcuts and grantsToShortcuts via put() without the duplicate-shortcut validation performed by postInit (lines 82-85). Specifically, line 113 unconditionally overwrites any existing shortcut entry in grantsByShortcuts if a newly deployed custom grant reuses an existing shortcut.
